accelerator_metadata.name: Ray Intersection Accelerator
accelerator_metadata.integration_topology: Embedded directly inside each Unified Shading Cluster (USC)

hardware_traversal_stack.storage_technology: Dedicated ultra-fast on-chip SRAM stack per ray lane
hardware_traversal_stack.spill_mechanism: Dynamic spill buffer allocation in Threadgroup SRAM on stack overflow (>32 levels)

aabb_intersection_units.test_algorithm: Parallel ray-slab intersection test with IEEE 754 floating-point handling

mathematical_formulation.slab_x: t1 = (box.min_x - ray.origin_x) * ray.inv_dir_x; t2 = (box.max_x - ray.origin_x) * ray.inv_dir_x
mathematical_formulation.slab_y: t3 = (box.min_y - ray.origin_y) * ray.inv_dir_y; t4 = (box.max_y - ray.origin_y) * ray.inv_dir_y
mathematical_formulation.slab_z: t5 = (box.min_z - ray.origin_z) * ray.inv_dir_z; t6 = (box.max_z - ray.origin_z) * ray.inv_dir_z
mathematical_formulation.t_enter: max(max(min(t1, t2), min(t3, t4)), min(t5, t6))
mathematical_formulation.t_exit: min(min(max(t1, t2), max(t3, t4)), max(t5, t6))

aabb_intersection_units.quad_child_evaluation: Evaluates all 4 child bounding boxes of a BVH4 node in a single clock cycle

operations: Origin vector transformation: O_prime = M * O + Translation
Direction vector transformation: D_prime = M * D
Ray normalization compensation factor calculation for hit distance scale
Homogeneous coordinate transform: [X_prime, Y_prime, Z_prime, W_prime]^T = M_4x4 * [O_x, O_y, O_z, 1]^T
Perspective divide: O_prime = (X_prime / W_prime, Y_prime / W_prime, Z_prime / W_prime)
Direction vector projective transformation and differential re-projection
Ray t_min and t_max interval scaling under non-uniform projective warp

in_flight_transform_engine.tlas_to_blas_handoff: Seamless pipeline transition with zero pipeline flush when descending from TLAS instance to BLAS root

priority_ordered_traversal_and_culling.child_sorting_logic: 4-way hardware distance comparator sorting child hits by ascending t_enter
priority_ordered_traversal_and_culling.traversal_order: Closest child visited immediately; remaining hits pushed to hardware stack in descending distance order
priority_ordered_traversal_and_culling.subtree_culling: Prunes any child node where t_enter > current_closest_hit_t
priority_ordered_traversal_and_culling.degenerate_culling: Zero-cycle bypass for empty or non-intersecting child entries

coherence_sorter.clustering_criterion: Directional octant and Morton-coded spatial ray origin key
coherence_sorter.warp_regrouping: Dynamic warp regrouping across threadgroups to reconstruct dense SIMD32 warps
coherence_sorter.simd_efficiency_gain: Up to 3.8x throughput improvement for divergent secondary bounce / diffuse rays

shadow_ray_early_termination.mechanism: Halts traversal immediately upon encountering the first watertight primitive intersection within [t_min, t_max]
shadow_ray_early_termination.stack_evacuation: Instant hardware stack flush on termination without restoring state to registers

telemetry_and_stall_monitoring.description: Hardware performance counter tracking USC execution stalls due to RIA memory requests or BVH node cache misses
